correctness.rationale: The ten pairwise occupancy types are edges of K5. With x_e=c_e/s, U/s²=Q(x)=sum_(e<f) w_ef x_e x_f, w=4 for disjoint edges and 1 for intersecting edges. Independently reproduced exact rational exhaustive support/Hessian stationarity enumeration for all 1023 nonempty supports: maxima support categories include (4,12/11) exactly ten times, all others below. A singular stationary maximum admits a constant-value tangent line reducing its support until a negative-definite supported maximizer is reached. Winning x=(5,2,2,2)/11 have exterior marginal gap (24-17)/11, preventing larger-support equalities. Arithmetic integrality requires 11|s and achieves bound for every multiple. The exact optimization, not checking a bounded s, proves all s.

value.rationale: Sharp universal normalization for a canonical ecological co-occurrence score under a meaningful simple five-habitat occupancy model. The non-obvious 5:2:2:2 complementary triangle structure and strict four-vs-five habitat shift offer a mathematically motivated exact extremal classification, not an arbitrary tiny numerical slice. Does not establish ecological competition causality.

final_claim: For s>=2 species occupying exactly two of five habitats each, checkerboard total U<=12s^2/11 (mean C<=24s/[11(s-1)]), with equality iff 11 divides s; up to relabeling unique 5t,2t,2t,2t support distribution on an edge and complementary triangle, ten fixed-site winning vectors.
